quotes.text: Convenient to Kings Beach- right next to the pier. We came up to Tahoe for the day. When my kids saw everyone kayaking, they wanted to do it too. We walked over, filled out a digital form and were on the water. Young ones can ride together just have to wear a life jacket the whole time. Super quick and easy and the staff was very friendly! This made our beach time that much more fun.

10/10 would recommend!! The booking and checking in processes were super easy. Parking at the King’s Beach State Park was SO convenient. The boat crew was so friendly and fun. I took my husband parasailing for his birthday, and had a blast! I splurged for the photo package which are just raw photos, but definitely worth it for the memories!

What a great experience every time I rent from these guys. We rented a jet ski for an hour and a couple of kayaks for another hour. All the guys were very helpful from check in, to going over the rules, to getting our equipment. Came at a great time - not too many people there yet and it was a Monday (was packed later in the day).

North Tahoe is great place to enjoy. cold water, clear water, nature. North Tahoe they also have watersports like PARASAILING, JET SKI, WATERCRAFTS, PADDLEBOARDS, PADDDLE BOAT, AQUA CYCLE and KAYAK. We tried parasailing and it was fun. Highly recommended and and definitely come back.

My daughter (12) and I had a ton of fun parasailing with the North Tahoe Watersports (Kings Beach) crew! We felt safe the whole time, and the crew did an awesome job at keeping us all hyped up and entertained. I love that their website made it super easy to book and make reservations, as well as sign waivers. The in-person stand for purchasing and checking in had incredibly long lines every day we visited the beach. Using the website to book was incredibly convenient.

We made the reservation a day before without any problems. Their online reservation system was simple to use. When we got there for our rental they were very nice and accommodating to my family. We had a small toddler with us and they had a life jacket for him ready to go. They gave great instructions on boat usage and features and were very patient while we loaded and unloaded the boat. I would say it was a true win using this company!
